_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_pd#1, and a falsification of its Signal. The rule holds (DOMAINBOUNDINGBOX must enclose every particle at every step) but nothing crashes when it does not. Shrinking the box on upstream particle_sph_2d_pdbody_gravity.4C.yaml makes 4C DELETE the offending particles and continue: the only trace is 'on processor 0 removed N particle(s) being outside the computational domain!', which names no id, no position, no step and no phase. It fires at setup and again mid-run. The run then completes and dies at the very end with 'expected 10 tests but performed 0' from core/utils/src/result_test/4C_utils_result_test.cpp, because the result-tested ids were among the deleted. Neither 'particle outside DOMAINBOUNDINGBOX at step N' nor 'position out of bounds' appears anywhere. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: particle(s) being outside the computational domain!

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the upstream 40x40 bounding box in the second arm. No particle is then outside, nothing is removed, the deck passes its own result tests and EXIT_SMALLBOX becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
